risks.proof: Close-up photos of drill head/bit area, pump unit, gearbox/drive, hydraulic manifold, and any serial/plate labels; plus a photo of all included rods/bits/accessories laid out.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete/unknown completeness (worst case: parts missing or worn).

risks.risk: Truck mechanical condition may be poor even if rig is okay
risks.proof: Odometer/cluster photo, engine bay photo, brake area photo, tyre tread close-ups, and a short drive video.

risks.proof: Readable spec plate/model number on rig and/or truck-mounted system; any brochure/spec sheet.

Send close-up photos of the rig’s model/serial/spec plate(s) and key components (drill head/bit, pump, gearbox/drive, hydraulic manifold).

response.reason: The seller’s statement of testing is not supported by any new evidence. Without operating footage and readable identification/spec information, the worst-case price cannot be set reliably.
